description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Arlluk Technology Solutions, LLC, a Koniag Government Services company, is hiring a Junior Software Developer to support its RACDW development team and a government customer. The role contributes to the design, development, and maintenance of database-driven web applications across the full technology stack.
Software Developer supporting senior-led full-stack development and maintenance of database-driven web applications, interfaces, and integrations

Responsibilities:
• Support ATS and our government customer
• Support the design, development, and maintenance of multi-layer, database-driven web applications
• This role will involve working across the full technology stack, contributing to application logic, user interfaces, and backend data integration under the guidance of senior developers

Requirements:
• The successful candidate must hold a bachelor's degree in computer science or software engineering from an accredited university and have entry-level experience with Java, SQL Server (or other relational database), and full-stack web application development
• Familiarity with multi-tier application architecture
• Relational databases and modern web technologies are required
• The role demands strong problem-solving skills
• Attention to detail and the ability to learn quickly while contributing effectively to a team-based development effort
• Ability to obtain a Public Trust
